notes: No.7 (project "No.7"): the shared No.10 body re-skinned (skin #d69668/#b06e4a/#74422c, his own short dark hair #463428/#281c16, yellow "7"; MOTION_LIBRARY §4), same scale (98 px standing, ground row 102). Front view; the shot 6 diptych's right panel. The brief MIRRORS No.10's Point for No.7 (Q1 = P2, Q2 = P3a, Q2b = P3b mirrored + re-skinned), so this strip follows library §1.4: No7Point.png faces EAST (like No.10's Point, "7" readable) and No7Point_west.png is the mirrored use. Draw the diptych with flip: true: the west strip IS the studio art pixel for pixel (No.7 pointing back across at No.10, screen-left, "7" upright). The east strip is derived by the export (studio art mirrored, the "7" re-pasted un-mirrored, light from the other side). Anchors are in EAST frame coordinates (studioAnim mirrors them with the west strip): contact (64,102) body centre; tip = the index fingertip (106,37) on Q2/Q2b (west art (21,37); point2: his right arm points out to the gutter; was (84,39) polish, (87,41) shipped), the closed fist on Q1. Shot 6: Q1 1.40, Q2 1.55-1.85, Q2b 1.85-1.97 (blink, off-beat from No.10's 1.95), Q2 1.97-2.40. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Studio layer: Art only (numbers in Art; no Num/Ball layer, MERIDIAN plan §7.7). The ball is never drawn in a frame: the game draws it at ball/boot.
